turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
t, but the timing really matters.

Before the lender accepts: You can cancel anytime, and your payment authorisation is released immediately.
After acceptance:
10+ days before start date: 100% refund.
10 days–72 hours before: 30% fee (70% refunded).
Less than 72 hours before: 50% fee, and the 50% refund is in platform credits (requires lender approval).
Cancellation Policy for Rentals (effective 17th April 2026)
